description: This file is a makefile used for building packages in the OpenWrt project. It includes rules and variables for configuring, compiling, and installing software packages, as well as handling dependencies, source code management, and build environment setup.

methods.name: pkg_build_flag
methods.description: Defines whether specific build flags such as 'iremap', 'mips16', 'gc-sections', or 'lto' are enabled based on build flags.

methods.name: Build/Exports/Default
methods.description: Sets environment variables for build exports such as include paths, staging prefix, and linker flags.

methods.name: Build/CoreTargets
methods.description: Defines core build targets including prepare, configure, compile, install, and cleanup tasks.

methods.name: Build/DefaultTargets
methods.description: Sets default build targets, including download, core targets, and handling source modifications.

methods.name: BuildPackage
methods.description: Defines the process of packaging a software package, including dependency handling, pre-deployment checks, and target build steps.

calls: git submodule foreach git config --unset core.worktree
